title: Using passives
summary: Когда и зачем выбирать пассив вместо актива: неизвестный или неважный исполнитель, порядок «известное → новое», безличный стиль; get-пассив, have something done и глаголы, которые в пассиве не употребляются.
ru:
## Зачем нужен пассив
Грамматически почти любое предложение с дополнением можно превратить в пассив, но выбор между активом и пассивом — вопрос **стиля и логики подачи информации**. Пассив уместен, когда:
- **исполнитель неизвестен, очевиден или неважен**: My car **was stolen** last night. / The suspect **was arrested**.
- **важен предмет или процесс, а не деятель** — в научных и деловых текстах: The samples **were heated** to 80°C and **left** for an hour.
- **нужно связать предложения**: в английском принято начинать предложение с уже известного, а новое оставлять в конце. The museum **was designed by a young architect**. It **was completed** in 1998.
- **нужен безличный, дистанцированный или вежливый тон**: Your application **cannot be processed** without a signature. / Mistakes **were made**. (не называем виновного)
- **не хотим ставить длинную группу в начало**: *A collector who had spent years looking for the painting bought it.* (грамматично, но громоздко) → The painting **was bought by a collector** who had spent years looking for it.

## by + исполнитель, with + инструмент
Группа **by …** нужна, только если она **добавляет информацию**: This novel **was written by a teenager**. / He **was elected by** 62% of voters. Фразы вроде *by someone, by people, by the police* (когда это и так ясно) лишние.
> The door **was opened with a key**. — Дверь открыли ключом. (инструмент)
> The door **was opened by a burglar**. — Дверь открыл взломщик. (исполнитель)

## get-пассив
**get + V3** — разговорный вариант. Он описывает **событие, изменение, случайность** (часто неприятную, но не обязательно), а не состояние.
> He **got fired** after the merger. — Его уволили после слияния.
> We're **getting married** in June. — Мы женимся в июне.
> Be careful: that vase might **get broken**.
Не используем get-пассив для состояний и со стативными глаголами: ~~She gets loved by everyone.~~ → She **is loved**. Исполнитель с get-пассивом почти не называют. Иногда get подчёркивает, что подлежащее само «виновато»: He **got himself arrested**.

## have something done
**have / get + объект + V3** — «сделать что-то (чужими руками)» или «пострадать от чьих-то действий».
> I **had my car serviced** last week. — Мне обслужили машину. (заказал)
> She **had her wallet stolen** in Rome. — У неё украли кошелёк в Риме. (неприятность)
В американском варианте чаще **get something done**; британцы предпочитают have в нейтральном стиле.

## Что в пассив поставить нельзя
- **Непереходные глаголы**: happen, occur, arrive, die, exist, seem, belong, remain, consist, depend. ~~The accident was happened.~~ → The accident **happened**.
- **Стативные переходные глаголы**: have (обладать), fit, suit, resemble, lack, cost, weigh, contain (в значении «вмещать»). ~~He is resembled by his father.~~ → His father **resembles** him. ~~The shoes are fitted by me.~~ → The shoes **fit** me.
- **Актив с пассивным смыслом** («средний залог»): The tickets **sell** quickly. / This paint **applies** easily. / The door **won't lock**. Пассив здесь меняет смысл: *The tickets are sold quickly* — «кто-то их быстро продаёт» (о работе продавцов), а не о том, что на билеты большой спрос.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~The meeting was taken place on Monday.~~ → The meeting **took place** on Monday.
- ~~Many mistakes were made by someone.~~ → Many mistakes **were made**.
- *She had stolen her wallet* значит «она (раньше) украла кошелёк»; чтобы сказать «у неё украли», нужно **She had her wallet stolen**.
- Избыток пассивов делает текст тяжёлым: вместо *It was decided by the board that the plan be approved* лучше *The board approved the plan*.
en:
## Why use the passive?
Almost any sentence with an object can be made passive, but the choice between active and passive is a matter of **style and information flow**. We use the passive when:
- **the doer is unknown, obvious or unimportant**: My car **was stolen** last night.
- **the process matters more than the doer** — in science and business: The samples **were heated** to 80°C.
- **we want to link sentences**: start with what is known and end with what is new. The museum **was designed by a young architect**. It **was completed** in 1998.
- **we want an impersonal or polite tone**: Your application **cannot be processed** without a signature. Mistakes **were made**.
- **we want to avoid a long subject**: The painting **was bought by a collector** who had spent years looking for it.

## by + agent, with + instrument
Use **by …** only when it adds information: This novel **was written by a teenager.** Do not add *by someone / by people*.
> The door **was opened with a key.** (instrument) / The door **was opened by a burglar.** (agent)

## The get-passive
**get + V3** is informal. It describes an **event or change**, often unplanned, not a state.
> He **got fired.** We're **getting married** in June. That vase might **get broken.**
It is not used for states: ~~She gets loved by everyone.~~ → She **is loved**. The agent is rarely mentioned.

## have something done
**have / get + object + V3** means «arrange for someone to do something» or «suffer something».
> I **had my car serviced.** She **had her wallet stolen** in Rome.
Americans often prefer **get**.

## Verbs that do not have a passive
- **Intransitive verbs**: happen, occur, arrive, die, exist, seem, belong, remain, depend. ~~The accident was happened.~~
- **Stative transitive verbs**: have (own), fit, suit, resemble, lack, cost, weigh. ~~He is resembled by his father.~~
- **Active verbs with a passive meaning**: The tickets **sell** quickly. This paint **applies** easily. The door **won't lock**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~The meeting was taken place.~~ → The meeting **took place**.
- *She had stolen her wallet* means that she was the thief; to say it was taken from her: She **had her wallet stolen**.
- Too many passives make a text heavy: *The board approved the plan* is better than *It was decided by the board that the plan be approved*.
structure:
## Когда пассив, когда актив
| Ситуация | Лучше | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Исполнитель неизвестен | passive | My bag was stolen. |
| Исполнитель очевиден | passive | The suspect was arrested. |
| Важен процесс (наука, деловой стиль) | passive | The mixture was heated. |
| Новая информация — исполнитель | passive + by | It was composed by Ravel. |
| Нужна живость, ясность | active | The board approved the plan. |
| Исполнитель важен, подлежащее — он | active | A storm destroyed the harbour. |

## Три способа сказать «что-то случилось»
| Форма | Формула | Оттенок |
|---|---|---|
| be-passive | be + V3 | нейтрально, любое время |
| get-passive | get + V3 | разговорно, событие / изменение |
| have something done | have / get + object + V3 | заказал услугу / пострадал |

## Без пассива
| Тип | Глаголы |
|---|---|
| Непереходные | happen, occur, arrive, die, exist, seem, belong, remain, depend |
| Стативные | have, fit, suit, resemble, lack, cost, weigh |
| Средний залог | sell, wash, apply, lock, open (The door won't open) |

exercises.title: Актив или пассив?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в активную или пассивную форму (Past Simple, если не указано иное).
exercises.example: A new species of frog (discover) last year. → A new species of frog **was discovered** last year.

items.text: My laptop {{was stolen}} from the train last Friday.
The earthquake {{struck}} the coast at dawn, and thousands of homes {{were destroyed}}.
Our flight {{was delayed}} for three hours because of fog.
Something strange {{happened}} at the office yesterday.
The new regulations {{will be introduced}} next January.
She {{was born}} in Kyoto but {{grew}} up in Lyon.
The suspect {{was being questioned}} when the lights went out.

exercises.title: get-пассив и have something done
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужную форму (get + V3 или have + object + V3).

items.text: I need to {{have my car serviced|get my car serviced}} before the trip.
She {{had her wallet stolen|got her wallet stolen}} in Rome.
Last month they {{had their kitchen redesigned|got their kitchen redesigned}}.
Be careful with that vase: it {{might get broken}}.
My brother {{got stuck}} in the lift for an hour.

items.why: Подлежащее (землетрясение) — деятель, объект (the city) назван → **актив**: destroyed.

items.q: A: Who built this house? B: It ___ my grandfather.
items.why: Дом построен — пассив; новая информация (исполнитель) в конце через **by**.

items.q: This paint ___ easily and dries in an hour.
items.why: Средний залог: актив с пассивным смыслом, описывает свойство краски — **applies**.

items.q: Какое предложение лучше подходит для научного отчёта?
options: We heated the solution to 90°C ourselves.
Heating the solution we did to 90°C.
items.why: В научном стиле важен процесс, а не исполнитель → **пассив**.
**fit** (подходить по размеру) — стативный глагол, в пассиве не используется.

exercises.title: be, get, have и глаголы без пассива

items.q: In the 1990s the author ___ by critics all over Europe.
items.why: Это состояние/оценка, а не событие; get-пассив не подходит, нужен **be**.

items.q: Honestly, I'm sick of ___ stuck in traffic every morning.
items.why: После предлога — герундий: sick of **getting** stuck (get-пассив, событие).
have + object + **V3**: услуга, которую делает парикмахер.

items.q: She had her passport ___ at the airport.
This sofa ___ more than my car.

options: Tom is closely resembled by his father.
Tom is closely resembled his father.
items.why: **resemble** не имеет пассива; подлежащее — тот, о ком говорим.

exercises.title: Уберите неважного исполнителя
exercises.instruction: Перепишите в пассиве. Исполнителя оставляйте только там, где это указано в скобках.

items.prompt: Someone has cancelled the 8 o'clock train. → The 8 o'clock train ...
answers: The 8 o'clock train has been cancelled.

items.prompt: They will announce the winner at the end of the ceremony. → The winner ...
answers: The winner will be announced at the end of the ceremony.

items.prompt: Someone broke into our flat last weekend. → Our flat ...
answers: Our flat was broken into last weekend.

items.prompt: Hackers have attacked the bank's servers. (сохраните исполнителя) → The bank's servers ...
answers: The bank's servers have been attacked by hackers.

items.prompt: People speak Portuguese in Brazil. → Portuguese ...
The police have arrested three men who tried to rob a jeweller's. → Three men ...
answers: Three men who tried to rob a jeweller's have been arrested.

exercises.title: have / get something done
exercises.instruction: Перепишите или переведите, используя have или get + V3.

items.prompt: Somebody stole Tom's phone on the metro. → Tom had ...
answers: Tom had his phone stolen on the metro.
Tom had his phone stolen on the underground.

items.prompt: The dentist will check my teeth tomorrow. → I'm having ...
answers: I'm having my teeth checked tomorrow.
I am having my teeth checked tomorrow.

items.prompt: Я постригся на прошлой неделе. (have / hair / cut)
answers: I had my hair cut last week.

items.prompt: The firm dismissed her last week without warning. (get / dismiss) → She ...
answers: She got dismissed last week without warning.
She got dismissed without warning last week.

items.prompt: A plumber installed a new boiler for us last week. → We had ...
answers: We had a new boiler installed last week.
We had a new boiler installed by a plumber last week.

items.prompt: Someone has left the lights on all night. (убрать исполнителя) → The lights ...
answers: The lights have been left on all night.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, выбирая актив или пассив по смыслу.

items.prompt: Что недавно было украдено, потеряно или сломано у вас или ваших знакомых?
items.sample: My friend's bicycle was stolen from the courtyard last month.

items.prompt: Какую услугу вы заказываете у специалистов? (I have my ... done)
items.sample: I have my car serviced twice a year.

items.prompt: Какое событие в вашей стране или городе сейчас обсуждают? (используйте пассив)
items.sample: A new metro line is being built in the city centre.

items.prompt: Что с вами случилось неожиданно? (get + V3)
items.sample: Last winter I got stuck in a snowstorm on my way to work.

items.prompt: Что продаётся или читается у вас в стране особенно хорошо? (sell well)
items.sample: Detective novels sell very well in my country.

items.prompt: Где проходит или проходил ваш любимый фестиваль или мероприятие? (take place)
items.sample: The film festival takes place in the old town every June.
